about: The pasted list of Perth company addresses (2026-11-06) is an AI-written lead, not a source. Each street it gives was looked for on the company's OWN pages (the importer's 4-page read of 2-5 Nov, then a deeper read of up to 8 pages per site on 6 Nov, robots.txt obeyed). Corroborated claims need nothing new (the company's page is already the evidence). A claim no page of the company supports is kept as a REJECTED evidence row (never active, so it cannot become a pin). An address a company's own page calls postal, or gives only as the address of its legal entity, is a location of its own (not confirmed as a place of work, no coordinates). Two company pages that state an operating address the earlier read missed are added as evidence.
